name: BotNonAdminImpersonationPolicy
description: Policy for bots that are allowed to impersonate users except admins and bots. Admins cannot be restricted via RBAC, so impersonating them would allow privilege escalation; bots are denied too because system and application bots can edit policies and roles, this policy included. Attach this (or BotNonAdminImpersonationRole) to a bot instead of BotImpersonationPolicy to deny admin and bot impersonation.

rules.name: BotNonAdminImpersonationPolicy-Allow
rules.description: Allow the bot to impersonate users.

rules.name: BotNonAdminImpersonationPolicy-DenyBotUsers
rules.description: Deny impersonating bots. System and application bots can edit policies and roles, this policy included.
